I am an old man now, 72 years, and my plot for beans is very small, only a small piece. Beans do not need the white fertilizer like maize does — my father never used it on beans, and I never have either. I keep a little goat manure from my animals and I will carry some baskets to this plot before the rains come. I save my own bean seeds from last harvest, the same seeds my wife and I have planted for many years, and I do not have money to buy new seeds from the market.

For the work, it is only myself and sometimes my wife and one of the grandchildren help when they come. The plot is small so we can manage it ourselves — weeding two times, planting, harvesting. I have no money to pay anyone, and for beans on such a small piece, there is no need. I have no pump, no river close by for watering, so I wait for the rains like always.
